principle: All worldbuilding elements are removable, editable, versioned Lego modules, not irrevocable canon.

eras.label: First Mystery
eras.chronology: Mystryl era, pre-Karsus boundary -339 DR; verify finer windows

eras.label: Second Mystery
eras.chronology: Mystra era, -339 to 1358 DR, with historical exceptions

eras.label: Third Mystery
eras.chronology: Midnight/Mystra era, 1358 DR onward, including Spellplague and Second Sundering changes
eras.note: Present-day in-world DR date must be selected; do not equate with real-world 2026

timelineModel: Each of 30 books has three era-context layers; this does not automatically imply 90 separate published books
sevenTraversalCompatibility: Keep existing 7 traversals / 3-3-1 structure as independent replay dimension

economy.goldStandard: D&D gold piece; era and region exchange rates unresolved

workflows: Catalog historical publications without conflating publication date and in-world date
Map canonical zones and routes, mark homebrew overlays separately
Attach quests to locations, time windows, prerequisites and faction consequences
Assign equipment and spell rewards as locked until evidence and DM approval
Playtest three character journeys through each era's mapped content
Revise versions, archive deprecated modules, preserve quest history
safeguards: No deletion of canonical history on module archive
No automatic character item grants or gold transactions
No invented official geographic distances, routes or prices
No cross-era NPC appearance without existence and location verification
No claim of live automation or persistent game integration without tests
